Description: Pentasaur Tourelle is written two ways for the Flamer. Summary table (page 7): Tourelle is on Laser Maelstrom, Lance Missile Maelstrom, and Lance Thermique; Lance-Flammes has only Réduit les Couverts (−3). Card prose (page 21): Toutes les armes des pentasaures ont les capacités Tourelle.
Suggestion A: Follow table: Tourelle on the three main guns only, not on the Flamer.
Suggestion B: Follow card prose: Tourelle on every Pentasaur weapon, including the Flamer.

Description: The star-cannon Travois is named two ways. Summary table (page 6): unit Travois - Canons Stellaires, weapon Batterie Stellaire. Card heading (page 16): Batterie Stellaire. Army list name (pages 9, 12): Détachement de Travois - Canons Stellaires; contents: 3 socles de Travois - Batterie Stellaire. Example armies (pages 13–14): Travois avec Batterie Stellaire. Same stats (75 cm / 2 / 4+ / −1, AA).
Suggestion A: Games Workshop: Star Cannon. Unit/detachment Travois – Star Cannons; weapon Star Cannon Battery; army-list contents use the unit name.
Suggestion B: Call the unit Travois – Star Cannon Battery everywhere (match the card and contents line).
Note: Bright Lance and Missile Launcher Travois names already match.

Description: Travois AA, Artillerie, and Réduit les Couverts (−1) sit on the weapons in the summary table (page 6) and on the unit in the card prose (page 16). Tir en Mouvement and Ne peut pas être transporté are on the unit in both.
Suggestion A: AA on Batterie Stellaire; Artillery and Reduces Cover (−1) on Lance-Missiles.
Note: Shot rules; put on the weapon.

Description: Salamandre Réduit les Couverts (−3) is on Souffle de Feu in the summary table (page 7) and on the unit on the card (page 19). Infiltration is on the unit in both.
Suggestion A: Reduces Cover (−3) on Souffle de Feu (weapon).
Note: Shot rule; put on the weapon.

Description: Pentasaure - Lance Missile Batterie, Artillerie, and Réduit les Couverts (−1) are on Lance Missile Maelstrom in the summary table (page 7) and on the variant (unit) in the card prose (page 21). Tourelle is on that gun in the table; see issue 1 for the Flamer.
Suggestion A: Battery, Artillery, and Reduces Cover (−1) on Lance Missile Maelstrom (weapon).
Note: Shot rules; put on the weapon.

Description: Exodite Warriors are named three ways. Summary table (page 6): Guerriers Exodite. Army list and examples (pages 9, 12–14): Guerriers Exodites. Card title (page 15): GUERRIERS. Stats match (10 cm / − / +1 / 6, Pistolet Shuriken et Epée).
Suggestion B: Keep Guerriers only on the card title.

Description: Fusiliers is singular in the summary table and plural elsewhere. Table (page 6): Fusilier. Card and army list (pages 9, 12, 15): Fusiliers. Stats match.
Suggestion A: Fusiliers everywhere (match card and army list).

Description: Megadon is spelled two ways. Summary table, army list, and examples (pages 8, 12–14): Mégadon. Card title (page 24): MEGADON. Body on that card also uses Mégadons.
Suggestion B: Keep MEGADON on the card title only.

Description: Knight units include Chevalier in the summary table and card headings (pages 7–8, 22–23): Chevalier Bright Stalker / Stallion, Chevalier Fire Gale / Reaper / Storm, Chevalier Towering Destroyer. Army list (page 12) drops Chevalier: Bright Stalkers, Bright Stallions, Fire Gales, Fire Reapers, Fire Storms, Towering Destroyers.
Suggestion A: Games Workshop names without a Chevalier prefix: Bright Stalker, Bright Stallion, Fire Gale, Fire Reaper, Fire Storm, Towering Destroyer.
Suggestion B: Keep Chevalier on the table and cards only.

Description: Vyper Transport is named two ways. Table and card (pages 7, 19): Vyper de Transport. Army list (page 12): Détachement de Vypers, contents 6 socles de Vypers de Transport. Class Cavalry in the table; purchase slot Options — not a class clash.
Suggestion A: Games Workshop: Vyper Transport everywhere, including the army list.
Suggestion B: Keep Détachement de Vypers as the army-list name.

Description: Éclaireur is written with and without an accent. Army rule and unit abilities (pages 5–7, 15, 17–18, 20): Éclaireur. Scout company title (page 11): Compagnie d'Eclaireur. Same rule/keyword.
Suggestion B: Keep Eclaireur on the company title only.
Note: Keyword and army rule are one thing; English prints Scout for both.

Description: Wraithbone is capitalised two ways. Baron, Dragon Knights, Dragoons (pages 17–18): Bouclier de Moelle Spectrale. Visionary (page 19): Moelle spectrale.

Dragon Knights lore names a Lance Laser that is not on the profile. Card lore (page 17): armés d'une Lance Laser et d'un Bouclier de Moelle Spectrale. Summary table and card profile (pages 6, 17): Carabine à Eclats only; abilities Infiltration only (no Lance). Baron and Dragoons do have the Lance ability.
Suggestion A: Follow table and card profile: Shard Carbine; no Lance.
Suggestion B: Add Laser Lance / Lance from the lore.
Note: Table and card stats already agree.

Description: Dragoons lore names plasma carbines that are not on the profile. Card lore (page 18): redoutables en tir avec leurs carabines à plasma, and also Lance Laser. Summary table and card profile (pages 7, 18): Pistolet et Lance; abilities Infiltration, Elite (1), Lance (5+/PA 0).
Suggestion A: Follow table and card profile: Pistol and Lance.
Suggestion B: Add a plasma carbine from the lore.
Note: Table and card stats already agree.

Description: Fire Storm prose omits the Pulse Lances. Card lore (page 23): Le Fire Storm est équipé d'un Lance-Missiles. Summary table and card profile (pages 8, 23): Lance-Missiles (90 cm / 2 / 4+ / 0, Artillerie) and Lances à Impulsion (45 cm / 2 / 4+ / 0).
Suggestion A: Include both weapons from the table and card profile.

Description: Combat Walkers are called marcheurs de guerre on the Reconnaissance Walkers card. Card (page 20): plus légèrement armés que les marcheurs de guerre. Rest of book (pages 7, 10, 12, 20): Marcheurs de Combat.
Suggestion A: Combat Walkers (GW) in that sentence too.
Suggestion B: Keep marcheurs de guerre in the lore sentence.

Description: Soin is still in this draft. Psychic powers (page 5): Soin grants Médecin until the end of the turn. 3.0.0 said ignore for now.
Suggestion A: Print Heal; it grants Medic (rulebook name only).

Description: Grammar errors in the French. Éclaireur (page 5): choisi, Maitre Stratège, 10*10cm. Chance (page 5): jetons … fonctionne. Visionary (page 19): De plus visionnaire. Pentasaur (page 21): ont les compétences; à la capacité. Megadon (page 24): à en plus / à les capacités. Raptors (page 18): aussi utilisé; des leurs. Fire Knights (page 23): et Le Fire Storm. Travois (page 16): est une Artillerie et ont. History (page 4): est revenu, leur frères, entre elle.
